_note: How 'In Notion ↗' resolves (kit/hc.js). A slide's link goes to the first of its data-notion IDs found in `ids`, else to its data-notion-page in `pages`, else to its part's default page (`parts`). An empty or missing URL shows 'Notion page pending' (no link). S07 seeded `pages` and `databases` from the Notion index; S17 fills `ids` as rows are written (D-012 → the row's URL). Never put a URL here that isn't in the Notion index or a Notion row. Since 4 Oct: "slides", "details" (slide-id/detail-id or slide-id/*), "panels" (by panel title) and "covers" (by data-part) point into the condensed workspace and win over the older keys; edit plan/notion-v2/deck-links.json and run deck/tools/notion-links.py.
